source.description:
## PROBLEM
PR3 intentionally ships only three read-only MCP tools; operators still need a narrow surface to list applicable diagnostic probes and prerequisites without executing them.

## SUCCESS
knowledge_probes returns indexed probe metadata, prerequisites, provenance, freshness, and service routing using the existing service-knowledge index.

## SCOPE
packages/service-knowledge/src/service_knowledge/mcp/knowledge_probes.py plus focused tests and MCP registration.

## NON_GOALS
No probe execution, remediation, write tools, or PR3 scope expansion.

## CONSTRAINTS
Read-only; reuse indexed probe items and existing bundle/provenance types; no new dependency.

## VALIDATION
Focused unit and MCP protocol tests; default tool list contains the new tool only after this follow-up lands.

## OUTPUT
Implementation commit, tests, and docs update.

SCRUTINY: medium
